svg.title: One Dollar is all you need box banner
svg.desc: A long dark red gallery. On the left, ONE DOLLAR IS ALL YOU NEED in ivory capitals with THE TOKEN IS 1 and THE DOLLAR IS IN THE BOX under it. In the middle, a green cartoon one-dollar bill hangs framed under glass in a spotlight, behind a velvet rope. On the right, pink tokens fall from a big heap into a marble fireplace.
